basic_details.job_title: NIT Patna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Assistant, Field Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the National Institute of Technology Patna (Bihta Campus) has invited applications from Indian nationals for the project titled "SwarShiksha: Voice-Powered Learning in Indian Languages for Visually Impaired Children" approved by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) under the Advanced Research Grant (ARG) program. The positions are available for Project Assistant and Field Worker on a temporary basis for a duration of 3 years under Sanction Order No. ANRF/ARG/2025/005917/ENS dated 17-06-2026. rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in science or 3-years Diploma in Engineering and Technology.
rows.desirable_requirements: Candidates with BE/B.Tech in ECE, CSE or EEE. Experience in coding with C/Python/PyTorch/TensorFlow/MATLAB. Knowledge of GNU-Linux. Knowledge of Signal, Speech and Image Processing.

Proficiency in working with MS-Office, Excel. Prior experience in data collection from field and data pre-processing such as data cleaning, transcription, annotation. Proficiency in documentation and project report preparation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and coterminous with the project for a duration of 3 years. The consolidated fellowship is Rs. 29,700/- per month including HRA for the Project Assistant and Rs. 24,000/- per month for the Field Worker. Selected candidates shall be encouraged to register for Ph.D. in Electronics and Communication Department during the December 2026 session.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Patna Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from the official notification PDF. Fill in the application form with all required details and affix a recent passport-size photograph in the designated space. Prepare a resume highlighting relevant exposure. Scan the filled application form, resume, and true copies of all testimonials. Send the scanned copy of the application form along with the resume and scanned copies of all testimonials to email ids [email protected] and [email protected] on or before 6th November 2026 (EOD).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and the list of shortlisted candidates along with the date of interview will be notified via email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The candidate is expected to join immediately if selected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Advertised positions are purely temporary and are coterminous with the project. An applicant has to ensure the authenticity of the information provided in support of experience claimed, other documents and photograph (ID proof). No-Objection certificate has to be submitted by candidates who are already employed somewhere. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The candidate is expected to join immediately if selected.

faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in NIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers two posts: Project Assistant (1 vacancy) and Field Worker (1 vacancy) under the ANRF-funded project titled "SwarShiksha".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit scanned applications via email is 6th November 2026 (EOD).

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Project Assistant and Field Worker?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship is Rs. 29,700/- per month including HRA for the Project Assistant and Rs. 24,000/- per month for the Field Worker.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in science or 3-years Diploma in Engineering and Technology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for Field Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates may send the scanned copy of the application form (Annexure-I) along with their resume highlighting the relevant exposure as well as the scanned copies of all the testimonials to [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Are selected candidates eligible for a Ph.D. registration?
faq.answer: The selected candidates shall be encouraged to register for Ph.D. in Electronics and Communication Department during December 2026 session.
